title: Maximum angular velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be ω = 2 rad/s.

title: Centripetal force condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law, equating the maximum static friction force (μ₁mg) to the required centripetal force (mrω²).

title: Minimum table radius
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be R = 2.5 m.

title: Post-slip deceleration analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the sliding distance on the table using kinematics, with deceleration from kinetic friction (a = μ₂g).

title: Geometry for table radius
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the Pythagorean theorem to combine the disk radius and sliding distance to find the minimum table radius R.

title: Velocity at disk edge
description: Optional Criteria: The student may explicitly state the tangential velocity v₀ = ωr when the object leaves the disk.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's work should maintain consistent units (e.g., m, s, rad/s) throughout the solution.

title: Confusing friction coefficients
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses μ₂ (table friction) in the centripetal force condition for part (1), or μ₁ (disk friction) for the sliding deceleration in part (2).

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the kinematic equation for uniformly decelerated motion (v² = v₀² - 2ax) is set up with an incorrect sign for acceleration.
